stories.headline: Seattle Locks Charbonnet in the Barn Till October, and That Backfield Turns Into Free Land
stories.read: Well pardner, the Seahawks slid Zach Charbonnet over to the reserve list Sunday, which is the league's polite way of sayin' he ain't ridin' till Week 5 at the earliest. That knee he busted back in January never healed up in time, and now a whole month of totes is sittin' out there unclaimed. Rookie first-rounder Jadarian Price and holdover George Holani split the reins to open the season, and Price is the one I'd be stakin' a claim on. If the saloon's still got him goin' late in your land grab, that's the cheapest gold on the board this mornin'.

stories.headline: Mahomes Says He Feels Great, But Nobody's Signed His Ridin' Papers Yet
stories.read: Hold up there before you spend a premium pick on the fella. Mahomes says his goal is still Monday night against Denver, he ain't missed a rep all camp, and by every account he looks strong on the range. Trouble is, the doctors have not handed him final clearance to play in a real game, and Andy Reid keeps sayin' the same thing three different ways. Draft him if he falls, sure, but keep a spare horse saddled: Justin Fields is the man who rides if that clearance don't come, and a fella you can rent for one week beats sweatin' Sunday mornin'.

stories.headline: Ja'Marr Chase Bends a Knee in Practice, and Half the Saloon Panics Right on Cue
stories.read: Now this is how you make money on the Trail. Chase came up limpin' on a deep ball in camp, sat out the next practice with a sleeve on that left leg, and every greenhorn in your outfit started sharpenin' their pencils. Then the man himself said it was a hyperextension, nothin' serious, and that he could play tomorrow if you asked him to. If somebody in your league bumps the best receiver alive down two or three spots over a scare, you sit quiet, smile polite, and take him. That's a gold mine gettin' sold for the price of a shiny rock.
